components.description: Music features from a MIDI keyboard, in six groups (levels, beats, tempo, notes, harmony, form): the same channel names MusicFeatures publishes, every channel on every frame, at its rest value where MIDI has nothing (no sound level, no drums, no detected tempo). A seventh output, lanes, is MIDI only: laneNOnset and laneNVelocity, every strike by where it lies between the bass and the top note.

components.name: MidiFeatures

definition.description: MIDI input port id. Empty = any attached input.
definition.label: Device

definition.description: The MIDI channel, 1 to 16. 0 listens to all of them.
definition.label: Channel

definition.description: The touch curve: 0 needs a firm touch, 1 reads a light touch as strong.
definition.label: Sensitivity

definition.description: 0 quick, 1 slow: the envelope lag (0.05 to 0.35 s), the strike hold-off (1.2 to 2.4 s) and the chord hold-off (1.5 to 3.5 s).
definition.label: Smoothing

definition.description: Above 1: the tempo, claimed at confidence 1. 0: bpm is the project tempo, at confidence 0.
definition.label: Declared BPM
